g.text: Agents | Delegation, grounded tools and shared model generation
Layer 2 · Purple: model generation. Slate: tools. Dashed: logical A2A through the controller.
Three roles share default-model-config; only specialists execute their bounded MCP tool sets.
Tools and model generation are separate routes. Replies return to the requesting specialist or coordinator.
Logical A2A arrows pass through the controller; they are not direct worker-to-worker RPCs.
Retrieval state is copied per Pod; Feast/Milvus Lite/encoder execute inside Retrieval MCP, not as a Milvus server.
Drift MCP accepts 32–200 API snapshots (recorded run: 32) before PSI; MMD remains an independent offline study.
Trace export uses /iot-telemetry/v1/traces → observer → Jaeger, separate from generation/model selection.
